mapper.insert: insert into pay_reconcile_diff (id, biz_date, payment_no, channel_trade_no, diff_type, detail, status) values (#{id}, #{bizDate}, #{paymentNo}, #{channelTradeNo}, #{diffType}, #{detail}, #{status})
